personality_one_liner: A calm, elegant, and warm shared space that feels like a beautifully typeset modern magazine.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Use margin correctly. Do not cramp elements. Whitespace is a deliberate feature here.

do's: Skip glass entirely as the Editorial Mobile personality dictates.
dont's: Do not use blur or glassmorphism. Rely on solid surfaces and borders.

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Warm welcome to set the tone, with simple elegant email/password fields.

states.loading: Spinner centered on soft surfaceSecondary background.
states.error: Standard alert toast using error tokens.

screens.layout: Large Fraunces display title ('Tandem'). Simple DM Sans labels above inputs. Primary brand button sticky at the bottom.

screens.name: Home (Today)
screens.purpose: Anchor the user's day with an AI quote hero card and their morning routine checklist.
screens.layout: Top: Large Hero image card (hero_quote_bg) with a vertical gradient scrim and the AI daily quote in large white Fraunces text centered in the bottom 40%. Middle: 'Morning Routine' section with a list of checkable routine cards. Bottom: 'Shared Activity' summary card.

screens.name: Lists Hub
screens.purpose: A beautifully organized dashboard of shared To-do lists, Groceries, and Chores.

states.empty: Empty state illustration (empty_lists) with 'No shared lists yet' and a prominent 'Create List' CTA.

screens.layout: Editorial layout: Prominent section titles. Use a 2-column grid for lists, each card wrapped in a 1px border with no shadow, showing the list title, item count, and overlapping small initials avatars for the assigned users.

screens.name: List Detail
screens.purpose: Manage items in a specific list (To-dos, Groceries, or Chores).

states.empty: Empty state with 'List is empty' text and illustration.

screens.layout: Large Display title. Floating Action Button (FAB) at the bottom right for adding items (or sticky input at bottom). List rows have a leading checkbox, title, and trailing assignee avatar or quantity tag.

screens.name: Journal & Thoughts
screens.purpose: A hybrid space for capturing quick thoughts and longer reflective entries.

states.empty: Empty desk illustration (empty_journal) with 'Capture your first thought'.

screens.layout: A segmented control to switch between 'Thoughts' and 'Journal'. 'Thoughts': A masonry or stacked list of minimal cards containing short text snippets. 'Journal': Large, generous cards with the entry date prominent in Fraunces, mood tag, and a snippet of the reflection.

screens.name: Profile & Sharing
screens.purpose: Manage account settings and connect with a partner.

states.empty: Partner section shows 'Not connected' with a prominent invite CTA.

screens.layout: List-based settings view. The top section prominently displays the connected partner's initial avatar and status. Includes inputs for sharing via username/email or generating an invite link.

empty_journal.alt: Minimalist blank notebook on a desk

instructions_to_main_agent: NEVER exceed font weight 500. Use Fraunces size (e.g., 24pt/32pt) to create hierarchy instead of weight.
Apply Editorial Mobile spacing: use `xl` (24) or `2xl` (32) margins between major sections to let the UI breathe.

For the Daily Quote Hero Card on the Home screen, layer the `hero_quote_bg` image, then a top-to-bottom vertical linear gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse at 80% opacity), then the white quote text in the bottom 40% of the card.
Do not use drop shadows or blur effects (glassmorphism is disabled for Editorial personality). Rely on `1px` borders and `surfaceSecondary` fills to separate cards from the background.
Use initials with `brandTertiary` backgrounds for user avatars when rendering shared tasks or connections.
Ensure the 'Start Morning Routine' UI is completely visible and easily checkable.
Ensure 'Thoughts' render as a minimal grid or masonry layout, resembling small, elegant torn-paper notes with clean borders.
